items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: We've had Jacques, Alvin Jacques playing.

ctx.x: Such as Ricky Mooney is the piano player with that. And we've had Irvin Charles playing. We've had Jacques, Alvin Jacques playing. Leroy Bro who's also my drummer with the brass band player. Ernest Watson. Fred Kemp. Stackman. Wendell Eugene is a trombone player who plays with both of all of my groups. Yeah. Yeah. Wendell and Mr. Trombone. Mr. Trombone. That's right. I won't do a recording session without him.
I don't know. That's kind of a trombone playing like he does is kind of a dying R.
